I'm running step 5 now. Both scan hits are real deferrals, so each gets a backlog item and a marker before the plan retires.

**1. Confirm this is a git repo.** The environment reports no repository here, but the session says we're on `feat/upload-retry`.

<command>git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree && git branch --show-current</command>

If this fails, I stop and tell you instead of using plain `mv`, because the retire commit can't happen without a repo.

**2. Append the plan's deferred items to the backlog.** The file exists (7 open items), so I append one section at the end.

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
## 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30
- [ ] Payload compression for station uploads (plan 12, Scope, descoped at
      planning): wanted before the winter deployment to cut the cellular
      data bill; needs its own gateway-side tests. See
      specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md; touches
      station/upload.py. Size: plan. Done when: station uploads are
      compressed and the gateway-side tests for the compressed payload pass.
- [ ] Fallback buffer size (plan 12, Task 2): left at 64 MB; no station has
      reported `BUFFER_FULL` in the last year of health logs. See
      specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md; touches
      station/upload.py. Size: quick-fix. Revisit if: a station's health log
      reports `BUFFER_FULL`.
</edit>

**3. Add the `→ item:` marker to each flagged paragraph in the plan.**

<edit path="specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md">
This plan covers the HTTP uploader in `station/upload.py` and its retry policy. Payload compression is deferred to a future plan: we want it before the winter deployment, to cut the cellular data bill, but it needs its own tests on the gateway side. → item: 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30
</edit>

<edit path="specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md">
When an upload fails, the uploader keeps the reading in the SD-card fallback buffer and retries it on the policy's schedule. Leave the fallback buffer at its current 64 MB in this task; make it larger only if a station's health log reports `BUFFER_FULL`, which no station has reported in the last year of logs. → item: 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30
</edit>

**4. Correct the status header.** It says "nothing deferred", which is no longer true now that two items are filed.

<edit path="specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md">
**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — executed via subagent-driven-development; deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md
</edit>

**5. Re-run the scan to confirm every hit is resolved.** I expect no output.

<command>uv run ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/scripts/deferral_scan.py scan specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/station-upload-retry.md</command>

**6. Retire the plan.**

<command>mkdir -p specs/plans/completed specs/completed && git mv specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md</command>

**7. Retire the spec.** The spec exists, no other live plan in `specs/plans/` carries its `station-upload-retry` suffix, and neither file has relative links to re-point. I mark it complete at the top, then move it.

<edit path="specs/station-upload-retry.md">
**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — implemented by plan 12 (specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md)
</edit>

<command>git mv specs/station-upload-retry.md specs/completed/station-upload-retry.md</command>

**8. Commit everything in one retire commit.**

<command>git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/completed/station-upload-retry.md && git commit -m "chore(specs): retire plan 12"</command>

**9. Re-check the backlog numbers.** The first summary line should now show 9 open and still `aged >45d: 0`.

<command>uv run ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/scripts/deferred_stats.py</command>

**Message to my partner:**

Both scan hits were real deferrals, so I filed them as backlog items and marked each paragraph `→ item: 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30`. I did not use `→ dropped:`, since that needs your word.

- **Payload compression** is a `Size: plan` item with a `Done when:` closure. You want it before the winter deployment, so it should age rather than sit as a watch item.
- **Fallback buffer size** is a `Size: quick-fix` watch item. Its signal is `Revisit if: a station's health log reports BUFFER_FULL`. If you'd rather say the 64 MB decision is final, tell me and I'll replace the item with `→ dropped:`.
- **Status header:** I changed it from "nothing deferred" to "deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md", since the plan now has two items. The backlog goes from 7 to 9 open.
- **Spec retired with the plan:** `station-upload-retry.md` had no other live plan and no relative links. I added a COMPLETE line at its top and moved it to `specs/completed/`.
- **Git check:** this working directory reports no git repository. If the first command fails, I'll stop there and nothing will be moved or committed.
